description: Kakunin provides identity, certificate issuance, behavioral monitoring, and compliance/audit tooling for AI agents. It issues X.509 certificates to agents, scores and logs their behavior, and exposes public verification artifacts for third parties to validate agent credentials.
summary: Kakunin exposes a documented REST API with an OpenAPI schema, a public no-auth verification/CRL surface on `api.kakunin.ai`, an MCP server at `https://www.kakunin.ai/api/mcp`, and an npm-distributed `kakunin-mcp` CLI; authenticated surfaces use Bearer auth with Kakunin-issued API keys, and OAuth resource metadata is also published for bearer access tokens.
